steps.title: Recognize a tool changer alarm and press RECOVER
Check the alarm page for guidance
Restore the tool changer and start automatic recovery
If automatic recovery fails, engage manual recovery
Use the manual recovery screen to move the tool changer components
Remove the tools from the double arm one at a time
Rotate the arm to origin and raise the pocket
Verify the recovered tools and update the tool table
Escalate when recovery doesn't fix it, and maintain the tool changer to prevent faults
